description: Find clients of the connected facturo account by name (typos and partial names are fine) or city; an empty query lists everyone. Call it before previewing for a client that may already exist and pass the client_id to preview_invoice. 'match' is 'exact', 'candidates' (one candidate: use it and name it; several: ask the user which one), 'none' (a new client) or 'all'.

query.description: Name, part of a name, or city
